explanation: The expedition's own article counts the War of the South among what the invasion force was made of: "In total 31,131 troops were landed on Saint-Domingue, including Mulatto officers such as André Rigaud and future Haitian president Alexandre Pétion, both of whom Toussaint had expelled from the colony two years earlier in the War of Knives" — the name that article gives this war. Precondition and not cause: the article says the war put those officers in France, where Leclerc's force was raised, and does not say the war is why Napoleon sent it. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
